metadata.title: TRIMME — Book your next haircut
metadata.description: Discover nearby barbers and salons and book a real available appointment in seconds.

home.title: Book your next haircut
home.subtitle: Discover shops near you, then choose the service, the barber and a time that is genuinely available.

signUp.title: Welcome to TRIMME

signUp.terms: I agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence you remember works well.
reset.doneBody: We signed you out on every device to protect your account. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

acceptInvite.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvite.subtitle: Create your TRIMME account to finish joining.
acceptInvite.invalidBody: The invitation has expired or was already used. Ask a platform administrator for a new one.

shopHome.suspendedBody: Shop data is unavailable for now. Contact the platform team to reactivate it.

empty.title: No shops yet
empty.body: Add the first shop, then invite its owner to finish the setup.

create.title: Add a new shop
create.slugHelper: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and dashes, e.g. al-asala
create.draftNote: The shop starts as a draft and stays hidden from customers until it is activated.

detail.suspendBody: The shop's accounts lose access to its data immediately. No bookings are deleted.
detail.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong or the shop no longer exists.

invite.title: Invite a shop account
invite.body: The invitee receives an email link to set a password. The link is valid for 7 days.

policy.title: Fields the shop edits itself
policy.body: Choose what the shop owner can change in their settings. Verification and the page link stay with the admin.

professionals.title: The shop's professionals
professionals.body: Each professional belongs to this shop only.
professionals.add: Add a professional to this shop
professionals.empty: No professionals in this shop yet

shopProfile.publicPhoneHelper: The shop's own number, shown to customers on the shop page
shopProfile.verifiedHint: After checking the commercial registration and shop documents
shopProfile.lockedHint: The platform admin decides which fields the shop can edit.

images.title: Images
images.galleryHint: Up to 12 images. Higher quality means better visibility in discovery.
images.uploadLogo: Drop the logo here or choose a file
images.uploadCover: Drop the cover image here or choose a file
images.uploadGallery: Drop a gallery image here or choose a file

locationPicker.title: Map location
locationPicker.search: Search for an address or district
locationPicker.noResults: No results. Try the district or street name.
locationPicker.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Search for the address or enter it by hand.
locationPicker.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be found right now.
locationPicker.dragHint: Drag the pin to the exact shop entrance
locationPicker.mapLabel: Map for placing the shop. Use the fields below to enter coordinates with the keyboard.
locationPicker.mapUnavailable: The map is not available on this device. Enter the coordinates and address by hand.
locationPicker.unresolved: No address found for this point — enter it by hand.
locationPicker.manual: Enter the address and coordinates by hand
locationPicker.changeWarning: Changing the location changes the distance shown in search results.
locationPicker.notSet: The shop location is not set yet.
locationPicker.readOnlyBody: The platform admin sets the shop location. Contact the admin to change it.

empty.title: No professionals yet
empty.body: Add a professional and choose the shop they work in.

create.title: Add professional
create.shopHelper: The shop is set when the professional is added and does not change afterwards.
create.slugHelper: Optional — made from the English name if left empty
create.whatsappHelper: Receives booking and reminder notifications. Never shown to customers or other shops.
create.notifications: Send WhatsApp notifications to this professional

detail.shopFixed: The shop is set only when the professional is added.
detail.uploadPhoto: Drop the professional's photo here or choose a file
detail.disableBody: They will not be offered for new bookings. Existing appointments stay as they are.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp & notifications
whatsapp.newNumberHelper: Leave empty to remove the number.
whatsapp.revealBody: Every reveal is recorded in the activity log with the reason and your name.

shopSettings.title: Shop settings
shopSettings.unavailableTitle: Settings are not available right now
shopSettings.unavailableBody: The shop is suspended. Contact the platform admin.

catalog.unbookable: Not bookable: one of its services is off, archived or hidden

shopServices.title: Services
shopServices.intro: Set your own services, prices and durations. Turning one on shows it on your shop page at once.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.body: Add your first service with your own price and duration.

emptyPackages.title: No packages yet
emptyPackages.body: Bundle two or more services with their own price and duration.

shopServices.archiveBody: It will no longer be offered to customers and stays in booking history and reports. This cannot be undone.
shopServices.deleteBody: Only a service never used in a package or a booking can be deleted.
shopServices.assigned: {count, plural, one {# professional assigned} other {# professionals assigned}}

form.nameEnHelper: Optional — the Arabic name is shown if left empty
form.priceHelper: Your shop's own price — up to two decimals
form.onlineBookableHint: When off, it can still be booked as a walk-in
form.packageServicesHint: Choose 2 to 10 of your services. The package has its own price and duration.

adminServices.title: Services & categories
adminServices.intro: Each shop sets its own services, prices and durations. Review them here, hide what breaks the rules and correct a service at a shop's request.
adminServices.caption: Shop services

empty.title: No services
empty.body: No shop has added services yet, or nothing matches the search.

detail.moderationBody: Hiding a service keeps it from customers without deleting it. The action is recorded with its reason.
detail.overrideBody: An exceptional edit of this one shop's service, with a clear reason. What changed is recorded before and after.
detail.overridden: Correction saved and recorded in the activity log.

empty.title: No packages
empty.body: No shop has created packages yet.

professionalServices.title: Assigned services
professionalServices.body: Only this professional's own shop's services, with that shop's prices and durations.
professionalServices.empty: This professional's shop has no services yet

subscriptionPlans.title: Subscription plans
subscriptionPlans.intro: Plans, prices and durations are managed here only. A new price applies to activations and renewals that start on or after its date; recorded subscriptions never change.
subscriptionPlans.caption: Subscription plans

empty.title: No plans yet
empty.body: Create the first plan, give it a price and publish it.

form.featuresHelper: Up to 12 lines, in both languages.
form.trialGraceHelper: Kept with the plan; v1 does not apply them automatically.
form.initialPriceHelper: Becomes price version 1 from today. You can also add it later.

detail.actionsBody: Only published plans can start new subscriptions. A plan that is not offered can still renew its existing shops.
detail.archiveBody: An archived plan cannot be edited, priced or assigned again. Existing subscriptions keep their history.
detail.pricesBody: Versions are never edited or deleted. Each one applies to periods that start on or after its date.

adminSubscriptions.title: Subscriptions
adminSubscriptions.intro: The platform team records activations and renewals here; there is no online payment. The status follows the end date and the expiring-soon threshold ({days} days).
adminSubscriptions.caption: Shop subscriptions

empty.title: No subscriptions
empty.body: No shop matches, or no plan has been assigned yet.

panel.none: This shop has no subscription. Discovery and online bookings follow the platform enforcement setting.
panel.assignBody: Choose the plan and the start date. The price in force on the start date is recorded with the period.
panel.renewBody: The renewal starts the day after the current end, or today after a lapse. Earlier periods never change.
panel.noPricePreview: This plan has no price on the start date.
panel.noPlans: No plan can be used. Publish a plan first.
panel.notesHelper: Optional, for example the contract reference.
panel.suspendBody: A suspended subscription hides the shop and stops new online bookings. Existing bookings are not changed.
panel.overrideBody: A shop-specific price and/or end date for the period in force, with a reason. The previous values stay in the history.
panel.customNotAllowed: Custom lengths and past start dates need a SuperAdmin override.
panel.customBody: A custom length or a start date in the past is recorded only with an explicit total price and a reason. The plan price is kept for comparison and the entry is audited.
panel.customPlanPrice: Plan price for one standard period: {price}

shopSubscription.title: Subscription
shopSubscription.none: Your shop has no platform subscription yet. Contact the platform team to activate it.
shopSubscription.ends: Ends on {date} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
shopSubscription.note: The platform team records renewals. There is no online payment.

warning.ExpiringSoon: Your subscription ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
warning.hiddenBody: Your shop is hidden from discovery and takes no new online bookings. Existing appointments stay valid.
warning.soonBody: When it ends, your shop is hidden from discovery. Existing appointments stay valid.
warning.contact: Contact the platform team to renew.

platformSettings.title: Platform settings
platformSettings.intro: These values apply to every shop, and each change is recorded in the activity log. More sections arrive with their features.

fields.expiredSubscriptionEnforcement: When a subscription is not in force
fields.hidePausedShopsFromDiscovery: Hide shops that paused online booking

enforcement.HideAndBlockNewOnlineBookings: Hide the shop and block new online bookings

platformSettings.enforcementHelper: Existing bookings are never changed, and shops can still record walk-ins.
platformSettings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

shopSchedule.title: Hours, breaks and time off
shopSchedule.deleteBody: The time becomes bookable again. Confirmed appointments are not affected.

hours.title: Shop weekly hours
hours.side: The outer limit for professionals' hours
hours.body: Changes apply to upcoming days only and never cancel confirmed appointments.

pros.title: Professionals' hours
pros.body: Each professional works within the shop's hours. The shop edits times only, never the profile.
pros.none: Your shop has no professionals yet.

breaks.title: Recurring breaks
breaks.body: Removed from bookable times on every selected day.
breaks.label: Break name
breaks.timesInvalid: Choose an end time after the start (5-minute steps)

timeOff.title: Time off and closures
timeOff.body: A professional's leave removes only their hours; a shop closure closes the whole day.
timeOff.empty: No upcoming time off or closures.
timeOff.effect: Their times are removed; the other professionals work as usual.
timeOff.closureEffect: The day is fully closed and takes no bookings.

closures.body: The shop is closed on the chosen days, including that day's hours after midnight.

conflicts.title: {count, plural, one {# existing appointment overlaps} other {# existing appointments overlap}}
conflicts.body: No appointment is cancelled and no message is sent to customers automatically. Contact them or reschedule yourself if needed.

pause.liveBody: Use it when you are overbooked or in an emergency. Confirmed appointments are never cancelled, and the shop leaves search results until you resume.
pause.pausedBody: No new online bookings are taken and the shop is hidden from discovery. Confirmed appointments stay valid.
pause.confirmBody: The shop takes no new online bookings until you resume. Confirmed appointments are not affected.
